rule: Firearms, airguns, ammunition, major weapon components, offensive weapons, pepper spray, stun devices, explosives, fireworks and hazardous chemicals or substances.
Illegal or controlled drugs, drug paraphernalia, prescription medicines, alcohol, tobacco, nicotine products, vapes and e-cigarette supplies.
Stolen property, counterfeit or replica goods offered as branded products, pirated copies, unauthorised digital access and goods that infringe someone else's intellectual property.
Recalled, banned or known unsafe goods, products missing required safety approvals, and items advertised with safety features disabled or removed.
Live animals, protected wildlife, ivory, goods made from protected species and human remains or body parts. Ordinary pet supplies are permitted.
Pornographic products, sexual exploitation material, material depicting child abuse, graphic violence or injury, and items promoting hatred or violent extremist groups.
Official identity documents, personal data, stolen accounts or credentials, counterfeit currency, tools marketed for fraud or theft, and services selling fake reviews or engagement.
Cryptocurrency or financial instruments offered as investments, gambling services, and any product or service whose sale is unlawful. Genuine collectable coins and banknotes may be listed.
